scope: Tiny paired local contracts;root-owned runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Define canonical bounded microbatch content
cases.input_contract: Validate the explicit bigint schema, nonnegative cents, positive IDs and at most 8 rows;return sorted id, cents newline records preserving multiplicity.
cases.expected: Exact text 1,100 newline 2,200 newline, with a stable SHA256 after repartitioning.
cases.verification: Compare exact bytes and reject NULL cents before publication.

cases.title: Publish one logical batch idempotently
cases.input_contract: Publish the same canonical content twice under identity manual-v1 and batch 7. Compare the existing receipt instead of appending.
cases.expected: First call publishes true;second returns false;exactly 2 logical rows remain.
cases.verification: Assert return values, unchanged receipt bytes and one batch file.

cases.title: Inject a real callback failure before publication
cases.input_contract: Run the actual foreachBatch query with failure after staging and before rename. Retain the wrapped streaming exception and attempted batch ID.
cases.expected: The query fails with injected_before_publication;no stream-v1 batch is visible and the attempted batch ID is 0.
cases.verification: Check the exception marker, empty published rows and inactive query.

cases.title: Recover the same checkpoint and observe replay
cases.input_contract: Restart the same source/checkpoint/query namespace without failure. Compare attempts and logical query/run IDs.
cases.expected: Batch 0 is attempted again and publishes 2 rows once. Query ID persists;run ID changes.
cases.verification: Assert attempt sequence 0,0, exact rows and corresponding identities.

cases.title: Expose a non-idempotent append counterexample
cases.input_contract: Append the same canonical batch text twice to a separate unsafe-demo file, then compare it with the idempotent published batch.
cases.expected: Unsafe append has 4 row occurrences;the committed batch remains 2.
cases.verification: Compare exact repeated lines and preserve the unsafe file as a separate diagnostic until owned cleanup.

cases.title: Reject identity collisions and admit the next batch
cases.input_contract: Reject different content under an existing batch key, then publish a new source file 3:300 and resume the real query.
cases.expected: The conflicting key fails without replacing its receipt. Stream batch 1 adds one row, leaving IDs 1,2,3 and total 600 across two batch files.
cases.verification: Assert collision rejection, old receipt equality, attempt sequence 0,0,1 and exact 3-row sink.
